title: Ticket booking API: error mapper answers the wrong status for a taken seat
name: Seat hold error mapping

questions.prompt: The mobile app is supposed to show 'Someone just took that seat, pick another' when a hold fails because the seat is already held, but it shows a generic 'Check your input' form error instead and the seat map never refreshes. Other failures (unknown event, malformed JSON, server bugs) look right. Fix booking/mapError.js so the tests pass.
